reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound, linking tensile strain to Pt isolation and d-band center shifts, which are well-established concepts in catalysis, though the direct causal chain from enhanced strain to improved selectivity and durability in this specific 7-element alloy is not yet proven.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and feasible, with specific measurements (electrochemical, CO-stripping, XRD/TEM) and a decisive falsification criterion, though quantifying 'enhanced tensile strain' and ensuring it is the only variable changed may be experimentally challenging.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis addresses a key mechanistic gap for a complex catalyst system and proposes a controlled experiment that, if successful, would provide valuable insight into strain engineering for high-entropy alloy catalysts.
